name: ai-customer-support-platform
description: A production-oriented multi-tenant AI customer support SaaS.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file ../../.env uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ai-support/web lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ai-support/web test && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-support/web typecheck && cd apps/api && uv run mypy app tests
